Every entry carries x-observed (when it was seen) and x-observed-evidence (how). An entry
becomes a no-op the day Hepsiburada publishes the same thing, so nothing has to be removed by
The date-filter entries below are the important ones. The document declares begindate and
enddate on these four operations, and production rejects them: every one of 28+ formats tried
against them returned 400 WrongDateFormat. Only the base /orders/merchantid/{merchantId}
endpoint actually honours the filter. This is worse than a missing feature, because the
neighbouring endpoint that DOES accept a date accepts an ISO-8601 value it cannot match,
answering 200 with an empty page -- so a caller who guesses gets silence rather than an error.
